Bitcoin Cash explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, Bitcoin Cash address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Bitcoin Cash targets one block every 10 minutes. ASERT adjusts mining difficulty after each block. The block subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks.

1 BCH = 100,000,000 satoshis. Fee rates use sat/B. Fiat values use the provider's Bitcoin Cash prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

Address history supports CashAddr and legacy Bitcoin Cash addresses. BCH amounts do not describe CashToken balances: token metadata and input quantities may be unavailable, and each affected view identifies that limitation.

The pending view shows a bounded provider sample, not a complete global mempool. Different nodes may see different transactions. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Successful retained responses carry X-BCH-Observed-At and X-BCH-Stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

GET /api/blocks/tip/height
GET /api/block-height/500000
GET /api/block/:block-hash/txs
GET /api/tx/bcf7ae875b585e00a61055372c1e99046b20f5fbfcd8659959afb6f428326bfa
GET /api/address/bitcoincash:qpazjhpjetdf287vyfvslgg868mdqs4p2v0583dq6t/txs
GET /api/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid

Live updates: WebSocket /api/v1/ws with action init, followed by action want and data [blocks, stats, mempool-blocks].

bch.tx.taxi - Bitcoin Cash block and mempool explorer
A tx.taxi explorer built from mempool/mempool
About bch.tx.taxi

bch.tx.taxi is the Bitcoin Cash explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and the live Bitcoin Cash mempool while using a Bitcoin Cash-specific tx.taxi identity.

Bitcoin Cash data

1 BCH equals 100,000,000 satoshis. Fees use satoshis per serialized byte: BCH has no SegWit weight discount. CashAddr and legacy addresses refer to indexed Bitcoin Cash history. BCH uses ASERT difficulty adjustment each block, a 600-second target and 210,000-block subsidy halvings.

Coverage

Mining charts show the latest 15 indexed blocks. Hashrate is estimated from observed work and elapsed time. Mempool charts reflect this session’s observations of one node, not a global pool. CashTokens are separate from BCH amounts; their raw category, units and NFT commitments are shown when present.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Bitcoin Cash network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

Privacy Policy
Updated: September 20, 2026



Use Your Own Node When Privacy Matters

bch.tx.taxi displays public Bitcoin Cash chain and mempool data through the backend configured by the site operator. For independent verification and the strongest network privacy, use your own Bitcoin Cash node and explorer.



Request Data

Normal website and API requests can reveal standard web metadata to the operator, including your IP address, user agent, requested URL, and request time. Server logs may be retained for reliability, abuse prevention, and debugging.



Local Preferences

Display preferences such as theme, denomination, fiat currency, language, and timezone may be stored in your browser. bch.tx.taxi does not require an account for ordinary explorer use.



Public Blockchain Data

Bitcoin Cash transactions, addresses, scripts, and blocks are public. Looking up an address or transaction can associate that lookup with your network metadata. Do not treat a public explorer as a privacy boundary.



External Links

This site links to tx.taxi contact channels, Bitcoin Cash documentation, and upstream source code. Those external services have their own privacy policies.



Open Source Attribution

Mempool names, logos, and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners; bch.tx.taxi is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V.

Terms of Service

Informational Explorer

bch.tx.taxi provides a view of public Bitcoin Cash blocks, transactions, addresses, mining data, fee estimates, and mempool state. It is an informational service, not a wallet, exchange, custodian, payment processor, or transaction-priority service.



No Control Over Bitcoin Cash Transactions

The operator cannot reverse, cancel, accelerate, recover, or redirect a Bitcoin Cash transaction. For wallet, exchange, or payment issues, contact the service that created or received the transaction.



Data and Availability

Explorer data may be delayed, incomplete, unavailable, or different from another node's view. Fee estimates are estimates only and do not guarantee confirmation. The service is provided as-is without a promise of uninterrupted availability or fitness for a particular purpose.



Acceptable Use

Do not abuse the website or API, interfere with service operation, bypass reasonable rate limits, or use the service unlawfully. Access may be limited when necessary to protect availability.



External Services

This site may link to tx.taxi contact channels, Bitcoin Cash references, upstream source code, and infrastructure dependencies. External websites have their own terms and policies.



Open Source

bch.tx.taxi is derived from mempool/mempool. Contact t.me/hiss for the current reviewed fork source package.
